name: cadvisor
title: cAdvisor
description: cAdvisor measures CPU, memory, network and disk use of every container on this host and offers them to Prometheus at /metrics, with a simple web page of its own. This one runs unprivileged with read-only mounts: CPU, memory and disk per container are there, per-container network traffic and out-of-memory kills are not. After deploying, add <this host>:8492 as a scrape target in Prometheus.

variables.name: PORT_CADVISOR_WEB
variables.label: Web port
variables.description: Host port of the web page and of /metrics

policy_needs.reason: cAdvisor reads every container's processor, memory and disk use from the kernel's cgroup files under /sys (read-only)
